method: The template is read with the RFC 6570 level 4 grammar: literals outside braces, and expressions of an optional operator, + # . / ; ? &, followed by a comma-separated variable list. An operator sets the prefix and separator, whether values are written as name=value, and whether reserved characters and existing pct-encoded triplets pass through (+ and #) or are percent-encoded (every other operator). A varspec may carry a prefix modifier :N, which keeps the first N characters of a string value and is refused on lists and objects, or an explode * . Values come from a JSON object: strings, numbers and booleans expand as text, arrays expand as lists, objects as name/value pairs, and null or a missing key is undefined. Undefined values are skipped, an empty list or object is undefined, and an expression whose variables are all undefined expands to nothing, prefix included. Every other code point is percent-encoded as UTF-8, and a pct-encoded triplet such as %2F is not encoded a second time under + or #. Literal characters outside the template grammar are percent-encoded and reported. Templates are limited to 2048 characters and the variables document to 20000. Nothing is fetched: the page does not resolve the resulting URI, contact the host, or prove that the API accepts the query or the escaping.
